texts.arguments: The contention of the Counsel for the petitioner is that on the basis of some inspection carried out, a report was prepared and thereafter an order came to be passed holding that the products manufactured by the petitioner was mis-branded and contrary to the provisions of law. 1 4. The neat contention of the Counsel for the petitioner is that no opportunity of hearing was granted prior to passing of the said order impugned. 5. Learned Standing Counsel based upon the instructions states that against the preparation of the inspection report, the same was served upon the petitioner, however, the same was not challenged, as such, there is sufficient compliance of the principles of natural justice.
